title: Status colors
description: Each status a scheme's product shows: its label, its tone, what it means, and the contrast of its color on its subtle fill in each mode. Drawn by the StatusColors composite on Foundations › Color.

label.description: The status label the product shows, such as Escalated.

tone.description: The status tone, which sets its color tokens.

meaning.description: What the status tells the reader, in a sentence.

contrast.description: The WCAG contrast of color.status.<tone> on color.status.<tone>.subtle, in each mode.

mode.description: The theme, such as light or dark.

ratio.description: The contrast ratio, to one decimal.
